grammar.title: 后置定语做修饰
lines: a favourite dish in Britain 英国一道受欢迎的菜肴 Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain. 炸鱼薯条一直是英国一道受欢迎的菜肴。
the divers on North Sea oil rigs 北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员 So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs. 所以，得知巨型鱼正在恐吓北海石油钻井平台上的潜水员时，这令人感到惊讶。
special cages made to protect them from these monsters 用来保护他们免受这些怪物侵害的特殊笼子 Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters. 现在他们已经制造了特殊笼子来保护他们免受这些怪物的侵害。
favourite eating varieties like cod and skate 像鳕鱼和鳐鱼一样受欢迎的各类鱼类 The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate .... 这些鱼不是鲨鱼或虎鲸，而是鳕鱼和鳐鱼等受欢迎的食用鱼类...

the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea 海底热油管道周围的温水 Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea. 有三个因素导致这些鱼长得如此之大：海底热油管道周围的温水。

the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs 钻井平台上的船员扔到海里的充足食物 Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs. 有三个因素导致这些鱼长得如此之大：海底热油管道周围的温水；钻井平台上的船员扔到海里的充足食物。

the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs 石油钻井平台周围完全没有渔船 Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs; the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs. 有三个因素导致这些鱼长得如此之大：海底热油管道周围的温水；钻井平台上的船员扔到海里的充足食物；石油钻井平台周围完全没有渔船。

expand.title: 主语的变化（哪些可以做主语）
lines: 英语考试中最重要的一点就是灵活多变，认清现象看本质即可！ 复合名词看成一个整体 不仅有固定的词序，且后面的谓语动词通常要用单数形式
名词、代词 I、Mr.wang I had a very good seat. §
doing 动名词 Fishing(常放句首) Fishing is my favourite sport. §
to do 不定式 to repair It was his job to repair bicycles. §
从句 主语从句 It was obvious that he was very embarrassed . § It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die . §

多个并列 A,B,C and E A , B or C A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me. 被看作整体的、用 and 连接的两个名词,当主语是 and 连接的两个名词时，谓语通常用复数形式 A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get .
bacon and eggs（咸肉和鸡蛋） Bacon and eggs are / is a classic breakfast combination.
bread and butter（面包和黄油） Bread and butter are / is essential ingredients for making sandwiches.
cheese and wine（奶酪和葡萄酒） Cheese and wine make (s) for a delightful pairing at dinner parties. 如果把两个名词看成是分开的东西，动词就要用复数
fish and chips（鱼和油炸土豆片） Fish and chips is a popular dish/meal in British cuisine. 通常被作为单数看待的有一道菜和一套东西
a knife and fork（一副刀叉） A knife and fork are / is necessary utensils for eating steak.
sausage(s) and mash（香肠和土豆泥） Sausage and mash is a comforting meal on a cold evening.
